stem.text: Which statement about butanone is correct?

A.text: Butanone can be dehydrated by concentrated sulfuric acid to give $\text{CH}_2\text{=CHCH=CH}_2$.

B.text: Butanone gives a positive result with Tollens' reagent.

C.text: Butanone reacts with $\text{HCN}$ by an electrophilic addition mechanism.

D.text: Butanone reacts with $\text{NaBH}_4$ to give a chiral product.
